prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Adoption visual style and photo quality enhancements (custom selectors, pre-upload inspection, compact grid, stage redesign, photo callouts), split-view path layouts, preset fast-track adoption, moving sign-in right after pet adoption, session safeguard hints, and wait-time progress checklists/tip carousels consistently won.
Worse performance: Desktop finish redesigns and guidance banners/flows, pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed callouts, path flexibility/minimalist copy, and interactive sound/visual wait progress caused significant losses.
No clear effect: Notifications, standard account sync/persistence flows, subsequent sign-in reorderings, desktop waiting overlays/time indicators, companion archetype flows, and carousel or two-column path layouts showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too low: Photo quality callouts, pre-upload style inspections, custom pet style selectors, split-view path screens, readiness/safeguard hints, and wait-progress tip carousels/checklists performed better than predicted.
Predictions were too high: Preset fast-track adoption flows, initial post-adoption sign-in reordering, split-view story intros, and all tests that resulted in no clear effect or negative performance were overpredicted.

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Full Bleed Companion Desktop Welcome Redesign: Redesign the final onboarding screen using a full-bleed layout with clear instructions on how to reveal and drag the pet on desktop. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% and support emails show confusion regarding how to control and locate the desktop pet after setup.)
1: [choose_path, new_flow] Story Scroll Intro & Selection Flow: Replace static story cards with a continuous vertical story scroll layout that transitions directly into path choices. (why: Choose path screen has a long mean time (514s), indicating hesitation that an engaging continuous scroll can resolve.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Session Persistence Warning Hint: Add an explicit hint explaining how signing in prevents companion loss across app reboots. (why: Directly addresses 8 support emails reporting reset or missing pets after sign-in.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Launch Readiness Checklist Component: Add a desktop system environment checklist component to the waiting screen during asset loading. (why: 3 support emails reported desktop visibility issues and home waiting screen has a mean duration of 2336s.)
4: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Badge Reward Component: Add a stylized certified companion badge component to the adoption certificate screen. (why: Reinforces emotional reward upon completion of pet adoption before moving into waiting and launch.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Companion Spawn Sound & Visual Switch: Enable sound and ready state notifications when desktop pet processing completes on the waiting screen. (why: Home wait time mean is 2336s, showing users tab away while waiting for their pet to be ready.)
6: [sign_in, reorder] Pre-Certificate Sign-In Flow Reorder: Reorder the sign-in step to appear before adoption certificate generation rather than after. (why: Ensures user account creation directly secures pet ownership before generating the final adoption certificate.)

scores.note: Finish desktop redesigns consistently underperform and drop conversion.
Story scroll intros tend to underperform compared to expectations.
Safeguard hints addressing account session loss consistently win.
Wait-time progress checklists perform well during long home wait steps.
Adoption visual polish and stage redesigns regularly yield positive lift.
Sound and visual wait progress changes tend to cause losses or no effect.
Sign-in step reorderings historically show no clear effect and are overpredicted.
